title: Sign-off matrix and tamper-proof audit trail for model rollouts
creator: Leah Nguyen
description: Define and deliver a lightweight but auditable change-management flow for model rollouts that covers canaries, A/B tests, shadow traffic, and automatic rollback triggers. The goal is to give Platform and Enterprise customers clear, enforceable gates (RBAC + required sign-offs) and an immutable audit trail for regulatory review and postmortems. This work bridges the rollout policy UX in Console with runtime enforcement in the serving control plane.
acceptance_criteria: A sign-off matrix UI that lets PMs/Eng/SRE/Legal select required approvers per environment (dev/stage/prod)
RBAC enforcement that prevents rollout promotion until configured sign-offs are present
Immutable audit entries for all rollout actions (plan, promote, pause, rollback) captured in the audit log with user, time, and artifact hashes
Configurable automatic rollback policies tied to runtime signals (error-rate, latency p95, regression on quality evals) and visible in Console
Audit trail export (CSV/JSON) for enterprise compliance requests with filtering by deployment, model version, and time range
tasks: Draft PRD and run stakeholder readout (PM/Legal/Security/Platform) - link in comments
Design: wireframe sign-off matrix and sign-off modal (DES handoff)
Eng: add RBAC checks to rollout promotion API and store sign-off metadata
Eng: append immutable audit events to customer audit log service with tamper-evidence (append-only storage)
SRE: implement automatic rollback hooks that consume runtime SLO signals
QA: create end-to-end tests that validate RBAC gates, audit entries, and rollback triggers
Docs: update runbooks and Console help text + enterprise compliance page
comments: 2026-02-19 - Leah Nguyen: Kickoff with Security and Legal. Legal asked for exportable audit format and retention guidance. Security requested tamper-evidence and KMS-backed seals for critical events.

2026-02-25 - Marco Silva: Initial API sketch posted in GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1872. API adds /rollouts/{id}/signoffs and stores signer, role, and timestamp. Waiting on schema review from ENG.

2026-02-28 - Priya Rao (Security): Suggested using append-only commit log (internally: audit-log-service) with HMAC of previous entry to detect tampering. Raised question about retention policy for EU customers.

2026-03-03 - Daniel Park (SRE): Prototype automatic rollback worker that subscribes to telemetry and marks a rollout as FAILED when p95 latency increases by >40% for 3 consecutive minutes. Needs configuration surface in Console for thresholds.

2026-03-08 - Design review (Ava Chen): Wireframes approved with two-step signoff modal, and ability to require cross-team signoffs (e.g., SRE + Security). UX note: don't block internal canaries by default to preserve development velocity.
2026-03-09 - Marco Silva: Implemented initial RBAC checks behind feature flag rollout-signoffs. Demo scheduled for 2026-03-16 with Platform PMs.
2026-03-10 - Leah Nguyen: Added compliance checklist and export example to Confluence. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RM/Signoff+Matrix+and+Audit+Trail
notes: Trade-offs discussed: strict signoffs by default improves compliance but slows release velocity. Decided: default to advisory for internal dev/stage, required for prod and any Dedicated/Private customers with enterprise policy enabled.
Rollout policy will map to existing runtime fallback behavior: when a rollout is paused/blocked, traffic will stay on previous stable model variant rather than returning 503s.
We will surface last successful sign-off hash in the rollout detail and include it in exported artifacts for audits.
Follow-up work items: add per-customer retention policy UI and integrate with KMS for event sealing (ENG-4120).
